what_it_is: End-game save. 100% completed, all level 99, max stats, all materia mastered, all items, all minigames completed with best scores, all side-quests completed, all treasure found, Max Gil/GP, Aerith is in the party.

gamefaqs.section: PlayStation PS3 Virtual Memory Card Save (ZIP) (North America)

format: zip of 1 PS3 export(s) (.PSV): '\0VSP' header (signature, save name at 0x64), the save's blocks from 0x84 (8324 bytes); it holds 1 save(s), 1 for this game (BASCUS-94163FF7-S01)
